description: This file defines the MemoryAppender class, a custom logging appender that stores a configurable number of log lines in memory, for debugging or monitoring purposes within the OpenMRS project. It acts as a wrapper around an older implementation, delegating calls to it if available.

classes.name: MemoryAppender
classes.description: A custom Log4j appender that stores recent log lines in memory and delegates to an internal implementation if provided; it is deprecated and has been moved to the org.openmrs.logging package in newer versions.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a log event to the in-memory buffer or delegates to the internal implementation if available.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the log buffer, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: getLogLines
methods.description: Retrieves the stored log lines, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: requiresLocation
methods.description: Indicates whether location info is required, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error message or delegates if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the current ErrorHandler, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the log layout used by the appender, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the appender, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: ignoreExceptions
methods.description: Indicates if exceptions are ignored, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the ErrorHandler for the appender, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the appender, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to the appender, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the associated filter, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Checks if a filter is present, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: isFiltered
methods.description: Determines if a log event is filtered out, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: removeFilter
methods.description: Removes a filter, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the appender, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the appender with specified timeout, delegating if an internal implementation exists.

methods.name: getPropertyArray
methods.description: Returns configuration properties as an array.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the appender.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the appender has been initialized.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the appender is started.

methods.name: isStarting
methods.description: Checks if the appender is in the process of starting.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Checks if the appender has been stopped.

methods.name: isStopping
methods.description: Checks if the appender is in the process of stopping.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the appender.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the appender.
